review.note: Merged in M22 into soares-elected-president-1986, which is the same event: the presidential election of 26 January 1986 and its second round of 16 February, the only presidential election ever to need one, won by Mário Soares. This record keeps the Wikidata id the import brought and names its survivor rather than becoming an anonymous tombstone.
